_about: Window glazing presets (whole-window U-factor in Btu/h-ft2-F and solar heat gain coefficient). A storm window over a single pane is entered as the single-pane preset plus storm_window: clear (the engine adjusts U and SHGC). Skylights: enter U-factor and SHGC directly.
